pages.title: History
pages.text_en:
1.0 Introduction:
Moshi Municipal Council is one of the seven Councils of Kilimanjaro Region. Moshi Town was established in 1892, and was relocated to its current location from Kolila Old Moshi (Moshi Rural) in 1911. In 1926 it was granted the status of a small town and in 1956 it was granted the status of a full-fledged city. It was granted the status of a Municipality in 1988.
1.1 Boundaries and Area of ​​the Municipality :
Moshi Municipality is surrounded by Moshi Rural District to the South, East and North, and to the West it borders Hai District. Moshi Town has an area of ​​58 square km, and lies between an altitude of 700 meters South to 950 meters North above sea level. Each square km. has a total population of about 3,165.
1.2 Administration:
Moshi Municipality is divided into 2 Divisions, 21 Wards and 60 Localities and has one electoral constituency. The Municipality has a total of 29 Councillors, of whom 21 are elected, 7 Special Seats and one elected Member of Parliament.
1.3 Population:
Moshi Municipality has grown from a small town with a population of 8,048 in 1948 to 184,292 according to the 2012 population and housing census which includes 95,118 females and 89,174 males.
Unlike other cities in the country, an accurate population estimate should include more than 76,000 people who spend their daytime hours in the city for business activities and benefit from the resources of the Municipality but live in areas bordering Moshi Urban and Hai Municipality. These people are not included in the budget, especially for the LGCDG system and other programs that provide subsidies based on the number of people present.
pages.text_sw:
1.0 Utangulizi:
Halmashauri ya Manispaa ya Moshi ni miongoni mwa Halmashauri saba za Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro. Mji wa Moshi ulianzishwa 1892, ukahamishiwa mahali ulipo sasa toka Kolila Old Moshi (Moshi Vijijini) mwaka 1911. Mwaka 1926 ulipewa hadhi ya Mji mdogo na mwaka 1956 ukapewa hadhi ya Mji kamili. Ulipewa hadhi ya kuwa Manispaa mwaka 1988.
1.1 Mipaka na eneo la Manispaa:
Manispaa ya Moshi imezungukwa na Wilaya ya Moshi Vijijini kwa upande wa Kusini, Mashariki na Kaskazini, upande wa Magharibi imepakana na Wilaya ya Hai. Mji wa Moshi una eneo la km za mraba 58, na upo kati ya mwinuko wa mita 700 Kusini hadi 950 Kaskazini toka usawa wa bahari. Kila km. moja ya mraba in jumla ya wakazi wapatao 3,165.
1.2 Utawala:
Manispaa ya Moshi imegawanyika katika Tarafa 2, Kata 21 na Mitaa 60 na ina Jimbo moja la uchaguzi. Manispaa ina jumla ya Madiwani 29, kati yao 21 ni wa kuchaguliwa, Viti Maalum wako 7 na Mbunge mmoja wa kuchaguliwa.
1.3 Idadi ya watu:
Manispaa ya Moshi imekua kutoka Mji mdogo uliokuwa na wakazi 8,048 mwaka 1948 na kufikia wakazi 184,292 Kulingana na sensa ya watu na makazi ya mwaka 2012 ambapo inajumuisha wanawake 95,118 na wanaume 89,174.
Tofauti na miji mingine nchini, makisio sahihi ya idadi ya watu yanapaswa kuhusisha watu zaidi ya 76,000 ambao wanatumia muda wa mchana mjini kwa shughuli za biashara na kufaidi rasilimali za Manispaa lakini wanaishi maeneo yanayopakana na Manispaa ya Moshi Vijijni na Hai. Watu hawa hawapo kwenye bajeti hasa kwa mfumo wa LGCDG na programu nyingine zinazotoa ruzuku kulingana na idadi ya watu waliopo.

pages.title: Vision and Mission
pages.text_en:
Mission
The mission of Moshi Municipality is to provide “the best services to the stakeholders through involvement of all municipal stakeholders in decision making, prudent use of municipal resources, appropriate environmental management and public- private sector partnership in municipal development”.
Vision
With regard to the vision, Moshi Municipal Council aspires to become “a model municipality in the provision of quality economic and social services to its stakeholders’
pages.text_sw:
Dhima
Dhamira ya Manispaa ya Moshi ni kutoa “huduma bora kwa wadau kwa kuwashirikisha wadau wote wa manispaa katika kufanya maamuzi, matumizi ya busara ya rasilimali za manispaa, usimamizi sahihi wa mazingira na ushirikiano wa sekta ya umma na binafsi katika maendeleo ya manispaa”.
Dira
Kuhusu dira hiyo, Halmashauri ya Manispaa ya Moshi inatarajia kuwa “manispaa ya mfano katika utoaji wa huduma bora za kiuchumi na kijamii kwa wadau wake”

pages.title: Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries
pages.text_en:
Objective
To promote transformation and development of agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and
fisheries.
Functions
The Division will perform the following functions:-
(i) To analyze, interpret and supervise implementation of Policy, Laws and
Regulation of agriculture, irrigation, Livestock and Fisheries;
(ii) To propose standards and prices of products and services from agriculture,
livestock and fisheries;
(iii) To prepare short and long plans and programs on development of agriculture,
irrigation, livestock and fisheries;
(iv) To oversee promotion and governance of cooperatives in the Council;
(v) To provide technical advice to stakeholders concerned with agriculture, irrigation,
livestock and fisheries;
(vi) To prepare reports on agriculture, irrigation, livestock and fisheries; and
(vii) To supervise collection and control of revenue from agriculture, irrigation,
livestock and fisheries activities.
